reason: The hypothesis combines the specific intervention of 0.5 at.% W alloying from the AlCoCrFeNiWx system (P19) with the adaptive tribolayer mechanism from the NiX CCA (P9, P7, P8) and the reactive wear protection concept (P6, P10, P15, P16), transferring this combined idea to a new, Al-free CoCrFeNi matrix. None of the passages propose or test this specific combination for the CoCrFeNi system, making it a synthesis of findings from different papers into a new proposal.
copied_elements: Adding ~0.5 at.% W to a CoCrFeNi-based HEA (P19, P2, P21, P23)
Lattice distortion from W addition (P19, P21, P23)
In situ formation of a nanocrystalline glaze/tribolayer for wear protection (P9, P7, P8, P1, P4)
